scope: Engineering stability of transferring the user-reviewed male-SKEL DMD37 reference to the exact SAM 3D Body MHR LOD1 rest topology. This is not medical validation.

source_topology.family: male SKEL skin sharing the 6890-vertex SMPL topology

candidate_definitions.DIRECT_SMPL: Apply each reviewed 6890-topology face/barycentric anchor to the official SMPL-on-MHR surface produced by mhr2smpl_mapping, then project that composed point once to the exact MHR LOD1 triangle surface.
candidate_definitions.HISTORICAL_SMPLX: Apply the existing project male-SKEL-to-SMPL-X nearest-vertex map, lift those SMPL-X vertices through official mhr2smplx_mapping, compose by the reviewed barycentric weights, then project once to the exact MHR LOD1 triangle surface.
candidate_definitions.projection_rule: Global exact closest point over all target triangles; persist chosen face, its exact vertex indices and barycentric weights. No point-specific manual reselection.

topology_and_provenance.gate: All source and target hashes/counts must match exactly; all 37 source face vertex triplets must match the frozen source face array; all official mapping indices and barycentric values must be numerically valid.

metrics: three pairwise Euclidean distances among the official MHR-lifted support points for each reviewed source triangle
diameter of those three support points
distance from their barycentric composition to the selected MHR surface
direct_support_locality.rationale: The three supports originate from one source triangle and must stay local. Thirty millimetres permits topology discretization differences but rejects a nonlocal fold or body-part jump; two millimetres limits the extra project-defined surface snap.

official_mapping_roundtrip.procedure: Lift all 6890 SMPL vertices from the MHR rest surface with mhr2smpl; reconstruct all 18439 MHR vertices from that lifted SMPL surface with smpl2mhr; replay each candidate's fixed MHR face/barycentric binding on the reconstructed vertices and compare with its point on the original MHR rest mesh.
official_mapping_roundtrip.rationale: This measures the available official map pair's local cycle consistency without claiming semantic invertibility. It is a diagnostic gate, not medical evidence.

required_metrics: per-point DIRECT_SMPL versus HISTORICAL_SMPLX Euclidean distance
normal and tangential components using the DIRECT_SMPL target face normal
mesh graph-geodesic distance when a reliable implementation is available
candidate_disagreement.geodesic_policy: Report exact/declared graph-geodesic method and value. If it cannot be computed reliably on the frozen topology, mark GEODESIC_UNAVAILABLE and do not substitute Euclidean distance under the geodesic name.

laterality_midline_order_symmetry.coordinate_convention: Canonical MHR rest coordinates in centimetres: +X subject-left, -X subject-right; dorsal/posterior is predominantly -Z. Axes must be verified from paired labels and canonical mesh before applying the checks.
laterality_midline_order_symmetry.order_gate: For the 14 declared bilateral BL rows (BL11, BL12, BL13, BL14, BL15, BL43, BL17, BL18, BL19, BL20, BL21, BL22, BL23, BL25) in source-record order, every consecutive centre must be lower in canonical Y by at least 0 mm; shoulder/scapular SI/GB points are excluded from this row-order gate and audited separately.
laterality_midline_order_symmetry.side_gate: All 18 LEFT, 18 RIGHT and the one MIDLINE point must pass their declared X-side threshold.
laterality_midline_order_symmetry.symmetry_gate: Every bilateral pair must pass all three pair-difference thresholds. Report failures individually; do not average them away.

posterior_region_sanity.numeric_gate: Each selected point must lie on a connected MHR body surface face and on the posterior half of its local canonical cross-section. Local cross-section is target vertices within +/-25 mm in X and +/-25 mm in Y; candidate Z must be no greater than that neighborhood's median Z. If fewer than 20 vertices exist, expand both windows to +/-40 mm and record the fallback.
posterior_region_sanity.normal_diagnostic: Report target face normal Z. Do not fail shoulder-edge points solely from normal Z because the surface can face laterally.
posterior_region_sanity.coarse_region_gate: Every selected face must be torso or arms under the frozen LBS engineering map; any legs/head/hands-feet assignment fails region sanity. The LBS map is engineering-only and not an acupuncture map.

canonical_visual_review.artifact: Render candidate identities under randomized neutral labels, with no method name, historical score or threshold shown to the reviewer. Include posterior, left-oblique and right-oblique canonical views.
review_questions: Are all markers on the visible exterior body surface?
Are left/right and midline placements coherent?
Do bilateral rows preserve plausible symmetry and cranial-to-caudal order?
Is there any obvious jump to head, limb, anterior torso or another disconnected region?
If two candidates are shown, is either visibly preferable or are they indistinguishable?
canonical_visual_review.blindness_rule: A reviewer who has seen candidate identities or historical comparison outputs cannot be recorded as blinded. Their review is CANONICAL_ONLY_NONBLIND. A separate reviewer with no method/result context may be recorded as BLINDED_CANONICAL_ONLY. If no such reviewer is available, blind visual evidence is INCONCLUSIVE rather than simulated.
canonical_visual_review.visual_gate: No obvious wrong-surface/body-region/laterality failure. Visual preference alone cannot override a failed numeric gate.

final_decision.PASS_DMD37_MHR_ENGINEERING_ASSET: All mandatory topology, locality, roundtrip, disagreement, side, midline, order, symmetry, posterior-region and visual-sanity gates pass. This means deterministic engineering stability only.
final_decision.BRIDGE_UNCERTAINTY_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Any mandatory gate fails, a required comparison is missing, or the evidence is inconclusive in a way that can change the selected bridge.

sensitivity_scope.allowed_after_bridge_pass: Parameter-to-engineering-point propagation on fixed MHR topology, decomposed into global rigid motion, pose, identity shape/scale and surface correspondence sensitivity.
sensitivity_scope.correction: Rigid global translation moves every MHR-bound point by exactly the translation norm in absolute coordinates and by zero after applying the same translation alignment; it does not test anatomical correspondence. Global rotation displacement depends on rotation centre and point radius. Pose/shape/scale results are model-parameter sensitivity, not image-model error, real-scene error, skin deformation accuracy or medical acupoint accuracy.
sensitivity_scope.blocked_until_bridge_pass: Do not interpret DMD37 sensitivity rankings or choose a mesh teacher from them while the bridge remains uncertain.
